title: QA: Ophan bugs and solid beams
eyebrow: Hand test for issue #463 (covering #464 to #467) and the page pickup, on the branch AjsAgent/gym-with-demand-page

short.lead: All five items are built, compile cleanly, and pass the editor tests (265 pass, 3 skipped, 0 fail). The scripted co-op checks kept failing because of where the script placed things, not because of the game, so the steps below are for you to play yourself. One script result stands: in one castle, 1,127 of the 2,802 ground-floor spots are under a roof, and 1,125 of those 1,127 count as cover.
short.hint: Open the game with the command in Start, then play each item in order. Each says what you should see.
items: Open the Ophan Gym in co-op

In Git Bash, from C:\Users\aj\Desktop\GameDev\PlunderSpell-demand, run: bash Tools/Unity/coop_local.sh --gym. It rebuilds the client if the game changed (the script's own estimate is 30 s), presses Play in the Editor, hosts, and opens a second window that joins. You should see the line "Co-op on this PC is up" and two windows side by side. The Editor is the host; the small window is the client. In the gym, F7 summons the Ophan, F8 stops damage to you, F9 removes the guards and F10 slows time.
Run it once; every item below uses this session.
Pick up the dropped page with E
In the Lair, tear the demand page at the ledger with E. With your hands otherwise empty, press Q to drop it. Stand within 3 m of the page on the floor, look at it, and press E.
You should see the page leave the floor and be back in your hands. Pressing F should do nothing.
The whole Ophan while you spectate

Set out on a raid and press F9 to remove the guards. On the host, pick up any loot so the Ophan hunts you, then press F7 to summon it. Stand in the open and let the slow beam kill you, so you become a spectator. Then repeat with the client carrying the loot instead of the host.
While spectating, you should see the whole Ophan, its top wings included, on both machines.
With loot in your hands, go indoors under a roof first, then press F7, and stay there.

After 3 s of the Ophan watching, it should charge (its rings speed up and its eye swells) and fire through the stone. If you stand in the open instead, you should get a 3 s lock-on and then the slow beam.
Solid slow beam and the growing charged beam
Stand in the open with loot and watch from the other player's window. Then, in a second run, step behind a wall while the slow beam is draining you.

The slow beam should read as a bright solid rod inside a soft glow. After 3 s behind the wall the Ophan charges: for those 3 s a thin beam should follow the target and grow wider and brighter until the Ophan fires.
After a charged beam hits a player behind a wall, walk to that wall in both windows (host and client).

There should be a hole 3 m across, its edge ragged by up to 0.5 m, in the wall and in any roof on the beam's line. You should be able to walk and see through it, and the floor under the target should still be there. The rest of that room should still stop the slow beam.
